title: Scarwall moves to the Badlands
changes: Scarwall, the Redfang capital, now stands in the north-west of the Red Badlands, up the paved road from Fangrock. Its east gate opens onto the north end of Gallows Canyon.
Gate wardens turn away heroes under level 5, heroes at war with the Redfang and heroes Wanted by them. A city's waystone now keeps the level rule too.
The old waygate to Scarwall is gone.
